Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <h3><strong>THE ROLE:</strong></h3> <p>As a Project Manager, you will manage a full workload of creative projects from inception through to completion, primarily standard-complexity, well-defined work. This includes identifying project scope, clarifying deliverables, anticipating needs, understanding timelines, and managing client and internal communications. You’ll need to be comfortable in the weeds, specifically helping to drive day-to-day deliverables, and ready to flag or hand off projects that grow beyond standard complexity.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage a workload of standard-complexity projects&nbsp;</li> <li>Scope projects and gathering requirements</li> <li>Managing projects end to end, flagging anything that grows in complexity or risk</li> <li>Following and reinforcing established project management processes</li> <li>Building, maintaining, and executing on timelines</li> <li>Setting up projects and managing them within Asana</li> <li>Vetting and analyzing project feedback</li> <li>Collaborating on detailed creative briefs</li> <li>Updating and maintaining project tracking</li> <li>Act as day-to-day liaison with clients on assigned projects</li> <li>Tracking of each project’s status; maintaining an intimate knowledge of the project’s health</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2-4 years experience in the project management field for an agency or on a creative team</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of digital creative and social media creative</li> <li>Great communication, people, leadership, organizational, and project/time management skills</li> <li>The ability to work both independently and in a team environment</li> <li>The ability to prioritize and consistently handle multiple tasks across multiple clients and teams</li> <li>Flexibility when it comes to changing priorities, while still meeting deadlines</li> <li>Attention to detail, while simultaneously seeing the bigger picture</li> <li>A willingness and ability to learn</li> <li>A positive attitude when executing tasks across accounts</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional things that will impress us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Asana (or similar project management software) a plus</li> <li>Strong Working knowledge of PowerPoint, Google Suite</li> <li>Experience in Slack or similar platform</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proficiency in the following programs/tools:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Google Suite (Slides, Sheets, Docs)</li> <li>Microsoft Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel)&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Mac/PC platform literate*</li> <li>Asana Software (not required but a plus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT DO WE OFFER?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage</li> <li>401K plan, plus matching</li> <li>PTO</li> <li>Paid Company Holidays</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.&nbsp;</p> <p>DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are a<a href="https://www.deptagency.com/the-good-company/becoming-a-good-company/"> B Corp-certified</a> company passionate about<a href="https://www.deptagency.com/the-good-company/"> purpose-driven work</a>.&nbsp; Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.&nbsp;</p> <p>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand &amp; Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology &amp; Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.</p> <p><a href="http://www.deptagency.com">Learn more about DEPT®</a></p> <p><strong><em>DIVERSITY, EQUITY, &amp; INCLUSION</em></strong></p> <p><em>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive.
